summary: For Azure Blob hub storage, create a secret with azure-account-name, azure-account-key, azure-container, azure-container-path and azure-connection-string, set spec.hub.storage_type: azure and object_storage_azure_secret, and restart hub API pods on an existing instance.
questions: How do I configure Azure Blob storage for automation hub?
Azure secret keys for automation hub storage

answer_card.title: Hub on Azure Blob
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: test-azure
stringData:
  azure-account-name: $AZURE_ACCOUNT_NAME
  azure-account-key: $AZURE_ACCOUNT_KEY
  azure-container: $AZURE_CONTAINER
  azure-container-path: $AZURE_CONTAINER_PATH
  azure-connection-string: $AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING
```
```yaml
spec:
  hub:
    storage_type: azure
    object_storage_azure_secret: test-azure
```
Existing hub: restart `<hub-name>-api` pods.
